scripts.dev: bun run db:generate && bun run --parallel --filter @peopleops/web --filter @peopleops/api dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @peopleops/web build && bun run --filter @peopleops/api build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run audit:files && bun run audit:boundaries
scripts.typecheck: bun run db:generate && bun run --filter @peopleops/contracts typecheck && bun run --filter @peopleops/api typecheck && bun run --filter @peopleops/web typecheck
scripts.db:fixture:deploy: bun run db:test:guard && bunx --bun prisma migrate deploy --config tests/fixtures/prisma7.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun run db:fixture:deploy && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:structure && bun run test:integration && bun run build
